rationale: Freeze domain-wise Ridge family after held-out rank validation, then use A6-A11 to calibrate scale-dependent amplitude for downstream Q2/Q3.
reference_composition: component-wise mean of normalized A4 train mixtures
calibration: observed L_k(N,p)=a_k(N)+b_k(N)*s_k(p)+epsilon; downstream centered correction uses b_k(N)*m_k(p)
extrapolation_policy: A12-A15 are not used to fit eta; keep as estimated/extrapolated pressure test.
interpretation_warning: Only three observed model scales. This is an empirical transfer correction, not a universal scaling law. Q2 must estimate N,D,Q scaling independently from attachment B.
